name: White People
overview: Scripture traces the origins of nations through Noah's sons, highlighting the genealogical foundation of peoples (Genesis 9:18). The New Testament reveals the inclusion of Gentiles, such as Greeks and Romans, into the faith through the work of the early church, exemplified by figures like Cornelius and Timothy (Acts 10:1; Acts 16:1). The gospel's reach extends beyond Israel, inviting all who are ordained to eternal life to believe and glorify God (Acts 13:48). This demonstrates God's sovereign plan to gather a diverse people into His kingdom, transcending ethnic boundaries.
